purpose: Isolate the effect of the supervision TARGET on eviction-scorer quality, holding candidate generation, cache simulator, trace preprocessing, capacities, request positions, history/scoring window, features, model family, training/validation resources, seeds, hyperparameter budget, and evaluation metric fixed.

objective_eviction_loss.description: Canonical finite-horizon eviction loss L_H(q,t), unmodified reference architecture.

objective_next_arrival.description: Distance (in requests) to the candidate's next reoccurrence.
objective_next_arrival.censoring_rule: censored at H (same horizon as objective_eviction_loss) for the primary variant; uncensored (trace length as sentinel if never reused again) for the secondary variant
objective_next_arrival.eviction_rule: argmax predicted next-arrival distance (evict what returns latest)

objective_reuse_distance.description: Forward reuse distance: number of DISTINCT other objects requested before the candidate's next reoccurrence (standard stack-distance-to-next-reuse notion, not the same as next_arrival's raw request-count distance).
objective_reuse_distance.censoring_rule: censored at H distinct objects for the primary variant; uncensored for the secondary variant

objective_pairwise.description: Next-arrival-ordering pairwise preference (HALP-style): i preferred over j iff i's next reuse occurs before j's. Independent of the eviction-loss/rollout computation.
objective_pairwise.eviction_rule: evict lowest-scored candidate under the trained shared pairwise scorer
objective_pairwise.model: shared-weight two-layer MLP, Bradley-Terry pairwise loss (reused from src/lafc/halp_model.py)

objective_pairwise_regret_derived.description: SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, not a primary comparison arm. Pairwise labels derived directly from eviction-loss regret (i preferred over j iff L_H(i,t) < L_H(j,t)). Prominently flagged as derived from objective_eviction_loss itself, per the task's explicit warning against presenting this as an independent objective.

horizon.note: Matches the fairness-protocol's scoped horizon (docs/evict_value_v1_fair_training_protocol.md). Primary analysis is horizon-controlled: objectives B/C/D censor future information at the same H as objective A.

folds: reuse configs/reviewer_fairness_cross_family_v1.json and configs/fair_cross_family_v1/folds/*.json UNCHANGED -- no new family rotation invented
metric: request misses / miss ratio over [score_start, score_end)

hyperparameter_protocol.selection_metric: min validation mean_regret (regret vs. best candidate's true label at each validation decision)
hyperparameter_protocol.search_budget_note: Same 3-family search space applied identically to objective_eviction_loss, objective_next_arrival, objective_reuse_distance. No objective receives a larger or smaller search budget than another.

expected_rows.scalar_objectives_total: 3 objectives x 7 folds x 3 capacities = 63 rows
expected_rows.pairwise_objective_total: 1 objective x 7 folds x 3 capacities = 21 rows

amendment_policy: Any change to censoring, horizon, model family, hyperparameter grid, or objective definition after viewing held-out results requires a new protocol_id (supervision_objective_ablation_v2) and a documented reason -- this file must not be edited in place after evaluation results are known.
